title: Shall We Play a Game
source: KEXP artist-confirmed lyric sheet (tracks 02, 04, 12) or Suno ID3 lyric sheet (all others except 19). Paper text is used exactly where it differs from the audio or lyric video. Unsung sheet lines are timed between neighboring lines. Who Follows Satan keeps Mike-approved on-screen text.

lines.text: Shall we play a game?
Future proves past.
Nothing is a coincidence.
The MAP is the KEY.
this was all planned in two thousand fifteen.
corruption and evil deep within.
treason at the highest levels!
have patience, there is no escape and there are no deals.
Why does it take the information going PUBLIC before JUSTICE is served?
foreign agents within our government at the highest levels.
NO private communications past, present or future.
NO communications made outside of this platform.
Any claims that contradict the above should be considered FAKE NEWS and disregarded immediately.
WHERE WE GO ONE, WE GO ALL..
Seventh floor is no more.
we see all.
we hear all.
the hunt continues.
prison.
death.
the puppet masters have been removed.
all vehicles of delivery removed and ALL strings cut.
You and your families are safe. (promise).
between four and six percent will be lost forever.
We are closer than you think.
Prepare and spread.
NO private communications past, present or future.
NO communications made outside of this platform.
Any claims that contradict the above should be considered FAKE NEWS and disregarded immediately.
WHERE WE GO ONE, WE GO ALL..
HELLO GEORGE.
